description: Source code for a Rust module implementing a gRPC client for a data broker, including connection management, error handling, and URI parsing.

classes.name: Client
classes.description: A gRPC client for connecting to a data broker, managing connection state, and handling authentication tokens.

classes.name: ConnectionState
classes.description: Enumeration representing the connection status: Connected or Disconnected.

classes.name: ClientError
classes.description: Enumeration of possible errors during client operations, including connection issues, status errors, and function errors.

classes.name: TokenError
classes.description: Enumeration of errors related to malformed or invalid access tokens.

methods.name: to_uri
methods.description: Converts a string into a Uri object, adding default scheme if missing.

methods.name: Client::new
methods.description: Creates a new Client instance with a specified URI.

methods.name: Client::get_uri
methods.description: Returns the URI as a string.

methods.name: Client::set_tls_config
methods.description: Sets the TLS configuration for the client (feature-gated).

methods.name: Client::set_access_token
methods.description: Sets the access token for authentication.

methods.name: Client::is_connected
methods.description: Checks if the client is currently connected.

methods.name: Client::subscribe_to_connection_state
methods.description: Returns a stream to subscribe to connection state changes.

methods.name: Client::try_create_channel
methods.description: Attempts to create a gRPC channel asynchronously.

methods.name: Client::get_channel
methods.description: Retrieves the current channel, creating one if necessary.

methods.name: Client::get_auth_interceptor
methods.description: Provides a closure to insert the authorization token into requests.
